description: This file contains utility functions for UI components such as form headers and footers, and functions for generating validation JavaScript and new record forms within the ProspectLists module of SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ProspectListFormBase
classes.description: A class used to generate forms for ProspectLists, referenced in get_new_record_form()

methods.name: get_validate_record_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for client-side validation of form data.

methods.name: get_new_record_form
methods.description: Creates and returns an HTML form for entering a new ProspectList record.
